skills.name: fieldnote-parallel-wave
skills.description: Implement a set of mutually-independent, ready-for-agent issues concurrently — one isolated worktree subagent per issue, each ending in its own PR — while keeping the orchestrator's context small and stopping at the human-merge gate. Use when several issues are unblocked at once (a "wave") and running them one-by-one would be slow; composes fieldnote-do-work + fieldnote-pull-request. Not for dependent issues, not for merging.

skills.name: fieldnote-prd-to-plan
skills.description: Turn a PRD into a multi-phase implementation plan using tracer-bullet vertical slices, saved as a local Markdown file in ./plans/. Use when the user wants to break down a PRD, create an implementation plan, plan phases from a PRD, or mentions "tracer bullets".
